$comment: The link stubs scripts/toolchains/linux-sysroot.ts adds to the Linux sysroot so a Rust · wgpu game links from a Mac or the Linux Studio: cpal (alsa-sys) needs libasound and gilrs-core (libudev-sys) needs libudev, each found through pkg-config. Each stub is built by the pinned zig for glibc 2.28 with the library's real SONAME and one empty function per `pub fn <prefix>…` the binding crate declares (their bindings are pre-generated, so no headers are needed); it is linked against and never run: players' systems provide the real libraries. The .pc versions are AlmaLinux 8.10's alsa-lib and systemd. Changing a row changes the sysroot's manifest pin (native/linux-sysroot/bundle-lock.json).
